acceptance: File source lookups traverse routing state and merge results through source policy.
evidence: KadTraversal now issues bounded find-node and search actions. Source-search request and response codecs round-trip target id, start position, size, entries, and direct source tags. Extracted Kad sources merge through SourceLifecycle with SourceOrigin::Kad.

acceptance: Completed or shared files publish source metadata when sharing policy allows it.
evidence: Kad source publish payloads are skipped when sharing is disabled. Enabled publish payloads carry file id, source id, direct TCP endpoint tags, and large-file source type truth.

acceptance: Keyword query packets and result parsing feed native search resources.
evidence: Kad keyword targets use the retained longest lowercase alphanumeric token rule and MD4 target hash. Keyword request payloads carry target id and start position. Search entries parse typed tags and can be deduplicated by result id.
